# brig sandbox logs

Show a sandbox's logs, such as the requests its policy denied

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox logs [VM] SANDBOX
```

## Description

Show a sandbox's logs, as openshell logs does: the gateway's records about
the sandbox and the sandbox's own, which name each denied request with its
method, path and the rule that refused it.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox logs dev webapp --since 10m --source sandbox
brig sandbox logs webapp -f
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-f, --follow` | keep printing new lines |
| `--level string` | only lines of this level or above: error, warn, info, debug or trace (default: info) |
| `-n, --lines int` | print this many lines (default `200`) |
| `--since string` | only lines from this long ago, e.g. 10m or 1h |
| `--source stringArray` | only lines from gateway or sandbox (repeatable; default: both) |
| `-w, --workspace string` | the workspace of the gateway to work in (default: $BRIG\_WORKSPACE, else default) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
